title: On the Convergence of Semi-Gradient TD: A Mean Field Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.20014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semi-gradient temporal-difference learning is a core algorithmic component of reinforcement learning, but bootstrapping with function approximation generally induces a non-conservative vector field and can lead to instability. We analyze this effect for two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime and identify a simple stability mechanism in which entropy-induced relaxation dominates the sensitivity of the moving bootstrap target. Under this condition, we prove exponential convergence to a unique fixed point and quantify its bias relative to the unregularized Bellman solution. We also show that the same mechanism extends to entropy-regularized off-policy control through soft Q-learning.

translated_title: 关于半梯度TD的收敛性：平均场视角
translated_abstract: 半梯度时序差分学习是强化学习的核心算法组件，但结合函数逼近的自举机制通常会产生非保守向量场，并可能导致不稳定。我们在平均场机制下针对两层神经网络分析了这一效应，并识别出一种简单的稳定性机制：熵诱导的松弛效应主导了移动自举目标的敏感性。在该条件下，我们证明了算法向唯一不动点的指数收敛，并量化了其相对于无正则化贝尔曼解的偏差。我们还证明了同样的机制可通过软Q学习扩展到熵正则化的离策略控制。
tldr: 该论文在平均场机制下分析了两层神经网络中半梯度时序差分学习的收敛性，证明了当熵诱导的松弛主导移动自举目标的敏感性时，算法可指数收敛至唯一不动点，且该稳定性机制可扩展至基于软Q学习的熵正则化离策略控制。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the convergence of semi-gradient TD for two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime, proving exponential convergence to a unique fixed point when entropy-induced relaxation dominates the sensitivity of the moving bootstrap target, and extends this stability mechanism to entropy-regularized off-policy control via soft Q-learning.
